The '''Zephyr-G swoop bike''',<ref name="VE" /> or shortened to '''Zephyr-G swoop''',<ref name="SW for kids">{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Surface Vehicle in Star Wars Movies|video=k7dVRY2QRV0|nolive=1}}</ref> was a type of [[swoop]] bike manufactured by [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders]]. [[Owen Lars]] owned [[Owen Lars' swoop bike|one]],<ref name="CV NE" /> which [[Anakin Skywalker]] used during his [[Mission to rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars|search]] for his [[Parent|mother]] [[Shmi Skywalker Lars]].<ref name="Episode II" />
